claude.rationale: This was a reverse-triangular merger acquiring the entire DelStar corporate group as a going concern, so the customer-facing product lines (DELSTAR, NALTEX, DELNET, etc.), the manufacturing processes, and the workforce/management "transferred together inside one going-concern vehicle," yielding no product-vs-process mismatch (gap_45=0). Because "the merger transferred the DelStar legal entities as a whole, the workforce and management running those operations moved with the vehicle," the processes and the people running them moved coherently together (gap_56=0). The acquirer's controlling intent persists (continue) with the business placed as a new Filtration segment; no Tier-1 fusion is documented. No transition-services agreement was needed since no gap exists (gap_mitigated=NA).
